text: {"reactions": [{"ad": "A1", "stopped": false, "understood": false, "believed": false, "why_not": "The caption is all about sourcing from China suppliers and business stuff which has nothing to do with me, and the picture is just a rustic sideboard with no price or info.", "intent": "No reason to click, not a business buyer and it tells me nothing useful.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A2", "stopped": true, "understood": true, "believed": false, "why_not": "I can already sew a button and I don't trust these cheap discounted kits, seen them fall apart and 41 vs 37 pieces is confusing.", "intent": "Might save it for a gift idea for my mum but I wouldn't buy it right now.", "intent_score": 2}, {"ad": "A3", "stopped": true, "understood": true, "believed": false, "why_not": "Looks nice but why does a toothbrush need a camera, seems gimmicky and probably really expensive and faffy.", "intent": "Might click to see the price out of curiosity but I wouldn't buy it.", "intent_score": 2}, {"ad": "A4", "stopped": false, "understood": false, "believed": false, "why_not": "I don't believe in astrology at all and the image of a coconut with a woman talking doesn't make sense to me.", "intent": "Would just scroll straight past, not for me.", "intent_score": 1}, {"ad": "A5", "stopped": true, "understood": true, "believed": true, "why_not": "I do actually buy rice but I get it at Tesco, I'm not downloading a new app just for this and 5kg is too much for me.", "intent": "Wouldn't click now but I'd remember Joybuy if I needed cheap groceries later.", "intent_score": 2}], "preferred": "A5"}
